title: fix(client-v2): format Duration nanos with Locale.ROOT in durationToTimeString

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- **[client-v2, jdbc-v2]** Fixed `Duration`/`Time64` parameter rendered with non-ASCII digits under locales like fa-IR/ar-SA (`String.format` used the default locale); now `Locale.ROOT`. (https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-java/issues/3308)
